title: Right Caret Air Intake & S-Duct
summary: Fixed-geometry diamond/caret supersonic air inlet and serpentine S-duct feeding the right F119 engine while shielding the fan face.
role: Supplies conditioned intake air to the right F119-PW-100 engine while minimizing frontal radar return.
materials: Composite ducting with radar-absorbent internal liner (public overview).
